---
name: Continue Interrupted
description: "After a digression: ask whether to resume the interrupted task."
routing:
  engine_managed: true
---

:::ordered_block id=main
name: default_continue_interrupted
steps:
  # NOTE: a stale wants_to_resume from an earlier digression can make this step
  # skip the resume ask on a repeat digression. The proper fix — resetting
  # skill memory when a (default) skill (re)activates, plus honouring
  # ask_before_filling — is tracked in ENG-2983
  # (https://rasahq.atlassian.net/browse/ENG-2983). Do not use
  # ``force_collection``: that key was removed and skill load rejects it with a
  # migration hint to ``ask_before_filling: true``.
  #
  # When this skill activates, the engine seeds public memory
  # ``interrupted_task_name`` with a human-readable label for the paused task.
  # The label uses normalized ``name`` or humanized skill id; when ``description``
  # is set and differs, it is appended in brackets, e.g.
  # ``Card Replace (Order a replacement credit card)``.
  # ``utter_ask_wants_to_resume`` interpolates that value; keep it declared in
  # ``memory.yml`` if you override this skill's responses.
  - id: ask_resume
    collect: wants_to_resume
    utterance: utter_ask_wants_to_resume
    description: "Does the user want to resume the task that was interrupted?"
:::
